# mdxcn

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-labs/mdxcn/tree/884eba5356762cf49f8828db8f861dc2f33d65e4/registry/default

MIT licensed source, vendored at commit `884eba5356762cf49f8828db8f861dc2f33d65e4`. Import paths point to local modules and `cn`. Browser components are included; Comark, Knap, and Next.js MDX wiring are not needed by this runtime.

Local presentation changes: unframed default, plain captions, CSS corner marks, and eight-series palettes. The report runtime supplies scoped theme styles and ReportSection / ReportGrid separately.
